name: Concord Biotech Limited
summary: Concord Biotech Limited, a, biopharma company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. It operates through Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Formulations segments. The company provides fermentation based active pharmaceutical ingredients in immunosuppressants, anti-bacterial, oncology, antifungal, and other therapeutic areas.
